# {{ site.title }} — Full Text

> {{ site.description }}

Source: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}
This file contains the complete text of every essay, pattern, and glossary entry
published on the site, for retrieval and long-context use by AI systems. Each
entry is delimited and includes its canonical source URL for attribution.
Diagram markup is removed; each diagram's caption is retained in place of it.
Question-and-answer sections are included in full.
